label: Faux Flemming — leurre de la zone résidentielle
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE full-body static fighter source cutout for CQC Versus Legacy. Transparent background.
Subject: the DECOY FLEMMING, the impostor from the Residential Quarters scene of the first METAL GEAR AC!D on PSP. Create exactly one adult man, not the real Flemming alias Gary Murray. This character reuses Flemming's final dark coat costume, with an opaque brown sack covering the whole head.
Image 1 is reference artwork for the underlying coat, trousers, shoes and body proportions only. Image 2 is the native game reference for the DECOY's actual bag covering, restrained dark costume palette, and identity. The bag is a compact dark tan/brown coarse horizontally textured sack, flattened/squared at the top, encompassing the head down to the neck, with no eye holes, mouth, face or visible hair. Preserve the modest native sack dimensions, not an oversized execution hood.
Preserve the long charcoal gray-brown double-breasted coat with broad lapels, long sleeves and worn uneven calf-length hems, dark black trousers, black shoes, dark belt with metal buckle, the small light shirt opening under the lapels. Follow the final costume in image 1, but keep the darkness and bag appearance of image 2; do not use Flemming's unused white laboratory-coat concept or green army pants.
Render a single full-body three-quarter view facing right in a restrained ready stance, both feet planted separately and entirely visible, knees slightly flexed, hands raised loosely at mid-torso in a natural defensive idle, no attack in progress. The coat and sack remain clearly readable. Detailed painted high-resolution 2D fighter sprite with restrained AC!D 1 palette, crisp silhouette and grounded fabric folds; not chibi, not a glossy photoreal human portrait.
Only the character. No Snake, Leone, background soldier, rifle in the background, room, floor, white brush strokes from the artwork, grid, cards, UI, typography, watermark, shadows on a floor, base, pedestal or backdrop. No blood, ropes, injury, extra limbs or invented armor. Full figure fits with a clear margin around every extremity. Actual alpha transparency; one image and one asset, no sheet or alternative views. Aim for a tall 2048x3072 composition if supported.
qaNotes: Art final et capture native effectivement inspectés : long manteau sombre, pantalon/chaussures noirs, sac brun entièrement couvrant.
Posture défensive adaptée en vue trois-quarts ; ce n'est pas une animation native ni une admission au combat.
Le leurre est distinct du vrai Flemming/Gary Murray ; le même costume ne prouve pas une identité commune.
La silhouette et les matières restent candidates à une comparaison externe 1:1.
scope: Une apparence statique du leurre portant le sac ; ne remplace pas le personnage Flemming réel, ses animations, son arme, ni ses séquences narratives.
